mapper.select: SELECT mno, id, pw, name, email, google_id AS googleId, kakao_id AS kakaoId, naver_id AS naverId, age, gender, phonenumber, birth FROM member WHERE google_id = #{googleId}
SELECT mno, id, pw, name, email, google_id AS googleId, kakao_id AS kakaoId, naver_id AS naverId, age, gender, phonenumber, birth FROM member WHERE email = #{email}
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET gender = #{gender}, age = #{age}, phonenumber = #{phonenumber}, birth = #{birth} WHERE email = #{email}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member (id, pw, name, email, google_id, gender, age, phonenumber, birth ) VALUES (#{id}, #{pw}, #{name}, #{email}, #{googleId}, #{gender}, #{age}, #{phonenumber}, #{birth} )
